newsitem.title: USA: Guidant cancels secondary equity offering.
newsitem.headline: Guidant cancels secondary equity offering.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Friday it canceled its secondary equity offering, citing the reduced valuation of its stock following the October 14 release of its third-quarter results.

The company also said it is comfortable with the current range of analyst estimates for its fourth-quarter earnings and expects growth in its fourth-quarter sales from the $260.1 million posted in the third quarter.

Chairman James Cornelius said in a statement, "We now have an IRS supplemental ruling that allows our stock to be used in an acquisition, and during the past two quarters we paid down our debt by $74 million to a total of $397 million. As a result, our ability to pursue a strategic acquisition program is not contingent on the secondary offering."
The First Call range of analyst earnings per share estimates for the fourth quarter was $0.54 to $0.61. In the same year-ago period, the medical device company earned $0.43 per share.
